2577-5670-7286.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-7286.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

When the creature dies, Vein Ripper and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Kheru Bloodsucker trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Bloodsucker trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

3234-3946-5147-7776.description:
While Glacial Chasm is on the battlefield, all damage that would be dealt to you is prevented.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm triggers. Choose not to pay its cumulative upkeep cost and sacrifice it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, its second ability triggers, returning Glacial Chasm and Mortuary Mire from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Glacial Chasm and Mortuary Mire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Glacial Chasm trigger, sacrificing Mortuary Mire.
Resolve the Mortuary Mire trigger, putting World Shaper from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 3.
Move to your next turn, drawing World Shaper during your draw step.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm triggers. Choose not to pay its cumulative upkeep cost and sacrifice it.
Cast World Shaper by paying {3}{G}.
Repeat from step 3.
3234-3946-5147-7776.notes: If your life total allows, you can instead opt to pay Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep cost. If you do this, you can forego doing this loop during that turn.

813-1987-3110.description:

Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
813-1987-3110.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.

Repeat.

Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

Resolve the remaining Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.

Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 7.

Cast Leonardo's Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.

When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Leonardo's Technique.

Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Leonardo's Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Leonardo's Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Exhibition Magician.
Resolve both Exhibition Magician triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

Repeat from step 2.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Repeat.

Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak

Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.

Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, adding {B}{B}{B} and untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
